description: Statistical leaders for a team season — each entry names the athlete, the stat, its value and the athlete's career URL. Also returns the qualifying minimums and the stat refresh time. Coverage varies by sport and by how diligently the school reports; an empty result is normal, not an error. Read-only.

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

team.description: Team site path or URL, e.g. nc/charlotte/myers-park-mustangs/football

name: maxpreps_get_stat_leaders
title: Get MaxPreps team stat leaders
